en.title: Eduardo Saverin: From Facebook Wealth to B Capital's Global Investment Architecture
en.deck: From a concentrated Meta stake to venture capital and the proposed Russell Investments acquisition: an examination of ownership, institutional mandates, returns, failures and financial power.
en.regime: Technology founder wealth used to build a transnational private-investment manager with possible institutional asset-management ownership.
en.key_risk: Confusing the founder's estimated Meta-linked wealth, B Capital assets under management and Russell client assets; the proposed Russell transaction was not closed.
watch: B Capital fund DPI and TVPI disclosures

B Capital portfolio losses and realizations

pt-BR.title: Eduardo Saverin: da fortuna do Facebook à arquitetura global da B Capital
pt-BR.deck: Da participação concentrada na Meta ao venture capital e à aquisição proposta da Russell Investments: propriedade, mandatos institucionais, retornos, fracassos e poder financeiro.
pt-BR.regime: Fortuna de fundador tecnológico utilizada para constituir gestora privada transnacional com possível propriedade de administradora institucional de investimentos.
pt-BR.key_risk: Confundir patrimônio estimado ligado à Meta, ativos geridos pela B Capital e ativos de clientes da Russell; a aquisição anunciada ainda não tinha sido concluída.
watch: Fechamento e aprovações da compra da Russell

producer_checks.information_cutoff: 11 November 2026; announced Russell Investments acquisition expected to close Q1 2027, not reported as complete.
producer_checks.research_depth: 18 substantive chapters each locale; 28 numbered verifiable references and 2 numeric charts plus two tables, two flows, map and mindmap.
producer_checks.evidence_sources: 25 aligned numbered institutional, regulatory, investor-industry and journalistic references in each language; SEC, IRS, Russell Investments, B Capital, ILPA, Reuters, Forbes, Bloomberg Línea, TechCrunch.
producer_checks.editorial_novelty: Separates founder equity wealth, third-party investment manager economics and proposed institutional-asset-manager acquisition; incorporates negative case studies, conditional falsifiers, social effects and governance.
producer_checks.visual_evidence: Two comparable numeric charts per locale: final fund commitments US$360m and US$820m for first two funds; Ascent II US$254m vs Ascent III US$500m, with same exact numeric arrays and units in EN/PT. Includes 2 tables, 2 flows, a mindmap and map.
producer_checks.bilingual_parity: Both 18 chapters with 28 identically numbered URLs and numeric chart series [360,820] and [254,500], same qualitative and financial distinctions.
producer_checks.source_check: Includes original primary B Capital June 2020 and Jan 2023 final-close disclosures, SEC, Meta 10-K, Russell, Forbes, Reuters, Bloomberg, ILPA and Moneycontrol; avoids counting an interim $410m fundraising figure as a final fund size.
producer_checks.editorial_status: Producer staged; independent SHA-bound QA required before publication.
